release_notes: v0.5.0-rc9: Critical cost-safe cancellation fix. Calls that have started STT/compliance processing (already billed) are now PROTECTED from cancellation and continue to save their results — only pre-STT, not-yet-billed calls are cancelled, and the batch settles COMPLETED with a separate cancelled count. Jobs-mode progress now reads the jobs rollup instead of staged_files, so a batch that is actively processing no longer shows 'Pending' forever. RC9 supersedes RC8. Prerelease build for RC validation.
